title: Cross-venue Bitcoin open interest aggregate API: BTC OI aggregated across 8 exch
description: Cross-venue Bitcoin open interest aggregate API: BTC OI aggregated across 8 exchanges (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Bitget, Coinbase, Hyperliquid, Kraken, MEXC) with per-venue 1h percent change, divergence detection (which venue is leaning accumulating vs distributing), max-divergence venue lean, and overall verdict. Cross-venue rotation signal that single-venue OI feeds cannot provide — detects when one venue is loading up while others are unwinding (institutional smart-money tell). Updated every hour.
